arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS mastercard_credit_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_brand = 'Mastercard' AND c.card_type = 'Credit'
arguments.explanation: Counts the transactions made with Mastercard credit cards.
assumptions: This is a follow-up to the earlier Mastercard count, narrowed to cards whose card_type is 'Credit'.
All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label.
